About.metaDescription: How Bloomprint turns yard inspiration into a buildable plan — and the principles behind it.
About.title: About Bloomprint
About.intro: Bloomprint turns yard inspiration into a buildable plan — what to buy, how much, what tools, in what order, and what can go wrong.
About.how1: 1. Tell us your goal, region, budget, and how much work you want to do.
About.how2: 2. A deterministic engine picks and scores plants, then builds the shopping list, budget, install timeline, and risks.
About.how3: 3. You refine with one tap (cheaper, easier, more privacy…), save, compare versions, and share.
About.diff1Bold: The plan is the source of truth, not the AI.
About.diff1: A rules-based engine builds every plan and works fully with no AI key. AI only rephrases and illustrates — it never invents plants, prices, or facts.
About.diff2: Prices are ranges, not quotes. Regions and zones are shown as “likely / approximate.” Assumptions are surfaced, never hidden.
About.diff3: Grouped “Buy First / Can Wait / Optional” shopping, a print-ready store list, weekend install timeline, and calendar care reminders.
About.privacyBody: Your account, profile, and saved plans are stored on your device. Share links encode a plan's inputs, not your data. Photos you add stay in your browser and are never saved. Analytics is cookieless and counts actions, not people.

Guide.title: How to turn a yard idea into a buildable weekend plan.
Guide.intro: A practical checklist for reading a Bloomprint plan, making safe pivots, and avoiding the common mistakes that make suburban yard projects expensive.
Guide.step1Body: Privacy, curb appeal, shade, low upkeep, or pollinators. Bloomprint translates that into plant roles and a build order.
Guide.step2Body: Unknown sun, soil, drainage, and local stock lower confidence. Use the accuracy prompts before buying.
Guide.step3Body: Buy First gets the project buildable. Can Wait and Optional upgrades are where you pivot if budget or hauling gets tight.
Guide.step4Body: Mark the bed, prep soil, place everything first, then plant tall-to-short and finish with edging or mulch.
Guide.storeRule1: Call before driving for plants, heavy materials, or large quantities.
Guide.storeRule2: Substitute by role, mature size, sun tolerance, and maintenance before flower color.
Guide.storeRule3: Do not tighten plant spacing just to make a first-day bed look full.
Guide.storeRule4: Use delivery or mulch pivots when stone, soil, or truck access becomes the blocker.
Guide.notPretend1: It does not know exact store inventory, aisle location, or live prices.
Guide.notPretend2: It does not replace local plant tags, bylaws, utility locates, or professional site work.
Guide.notPretend3: It treats AI as wording help only, never as the source of plant or safety facts.
Guide.notPretend4: It keeps working with no photo, no account, no API key, and no paid data source.
